SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4633
Date 11. 4. 33

D.C. (-R....)

Political

Movement of Notables
To Nanking
Met at 11.30 a.m. April 10 :
Tang You-jen, secretary of the Central Political
Council.
Chang Chün-mai, Vice Minister of Finance.
Ex-Marshall Chen, Kuo-hsing and Civil Affairs
left for Nanking this morning, April 10, by the 8.30
a.m. express.

Aviation Construction - activities of General Labour
Union and Chamber of Commerce
At 11 a.m. April 10, two representatives of the
General Labour Union called at the Shanghai Municipality
and requested the authorities to issue an order authorizing
the appropriation of the workers' wages for March 12, the
anniversary of the death of Dr. Sun, to the fund raised
for the purchase of an aeroplane to be entitled "Sun Yat
Labour". They were received by a secretary of the
Municipality who promised to refer their request to the
Bureau of Social Affairs.
At 10 a.m. April 10, 1933, the Chinese Chamber of
Commerce issued a circular notice to various traders
associations instructing them to organize fund soliciting
groups for aviation purposes.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER : [签名] APR 11 (CRIME BRANCH)）

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别课档案室
编号 D 4633
日期 1933年4月11日

副警务处长（-R ____ ）

政治类

要员动向
赴南京
4月10日上午11时30分获悉：
中央政治委员会秘书长唐有壬。
财政部次长张君劢。
前元帅陈国兴及民政官员于今晨（4月10日）乘上午8时30分的特快列车前往南京。

航空建设——总工会及总商会的活动
4月10日上午11时，总工会两名代表前往上海市政府，请求当局发布命令，批准将3月12日（孙中山博士逝世周年纪念日）的工人工资划拨至为购买一架命名为“孙逸仙劳工号”飞机的募款基金。市政府一名秘书接待了他们，并承诺将其请求转交社会局处理。
1933年4月10日上午10时，上海总商会向各同业公会发出通函，指示其组织航空救国募款团体。

（印：副警务处长：[签名] 4月11日（刑侦科））

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 4633
Date 11 / 4 / 33

Political (2)

S.M.R. Chinese Employees' Contribution for Aviation
Construction

According to instructions issued by the S.M.R.
and C.M.R. Special Kuomintang and the S.M.R. and
C.M.R. Railway Workers' Union, employees of the two
railways are required to contribute for six months
commencing from April 1, 1933, in support of the
aviation construction movement. The following is
the scale of contribution which will be deducted from
the monthly wages of the workers :-

Wages under $30 - $0.30 per month
" $30 - $50 - $0.50 " "
" $51 - $100 - $1. " "
" $101 - $200 - $5. " "
" $201 - $300 - $8. " "
" over $300 - $10. " "

Shanghai Christians National Salvation Men's Group
- Inaugurated

The abovementioned organization was formally inaugurated
in the Moore Memorial Church, 314 Thibet Road, between
4.30 and 5.45 p.m. April 10, some 300 persons attending.
Dr. C.T. Wang, ex-Minister of Foreign Affairs, who
presided, made a speech saying Christians should rise and
work for the salvation of the nation from external invasion.
He also stated that the object of the establishment of
this body is to save the nation on the principles of
Christianity.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别课档案室
编号 D 4633
日期 1933年4月11日

政治类 (2)

沪宁、沪杭甬铁路中国职员航空建设捐款

根据沪宁、沪杭甬铁路特别国民党党部及沪宁、沪杭甬铁路工人联合会发布的指示，两路职员须自1933年4月1日起，为期六个月，捐献款项以支持航空建设运动。以下是将从工人月薪中扣除的捐款标准：

月薪低于30元者 - 每月0.30元
月薪30元至50元者 - 每月0.50元
月薪51元至100元者 - 每月1.00元
月薪101元至200元者 - 每月5.00元
月薪201元至300元者 - 每月8.00元
月薪超过300元者 - 每月10.00元

上海基督徒救国男子团——成立

上述组织于4月10日下午4时30分至5时45分之间，在西藏路314号慕尔堂正式举行成立典礼，约有300人出席。前外交部长王正廷博士主持会议并发表演讲，称基督徒应奋起工作，拯救国家免受外敌入侵。他还表示，建立该团体的宗旨是本着基督教原则救国。
